style.styleTitle: Homcom 7ft Artificial Christmas Tree with 2719 Tips
style.toneOfVoice: Holiday setup can feel rushed, especially with pets or little ones nearby. The HOMCOM 7ft artificial Christmas tree eases that stress with auto-drop hinged tips that open more quickly. Crafted with 2719 dense PE and PVC tips, it delivers a full, realistic look. Flame-retardant materials add peace of mind during busy family moments, while a solid pine wood base brings a natural texture to your holiday decor. It helps your home feel festive, calm, and ready for seasonal celebrations. Classic Christmas tree design features a full-bodied profile. Crafted with realistic PE and dense PVC leaves for long-lasting natural beauty. Hinged tips drop automatically, making shaping quicker than normal trees. Sectional trunks make storage compact once festivities end. Flame-retardant tips help slow accidental fire spread for safer celebrations. A solid pine wood base delivers robust stability and adds an elevated, textured natural look. Versatile seasonal accent infuses an authentic forest touch and a vibrant holiday atmosphere into any indoor layout. Colour: Green. Material: PE, PVC, Pine Wood. Overall Dimensions: F118 x 210H cm. Base Dimensions: F70 x 15H cm. Tip Count: 2719. Item Label: 83C-293V04GN. Shaping Note: Approx. 30-50 minutes of manual branch shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness. Dimensions(mm): Height: 2133.6 Width: 1180 Depth: 1180.
